meta.name: cirq
meta.description: Google quantum computing framework. Use when targeting Google Quantum AI hardware, designing noise-aware circuits, or running quantum characterization experiments. Best for Google hardware, noise modeling, and low-level circuit design. For IBM hardware use qiskit; for quantum ML with autodiff use pennylane; for physics simulations use qutip.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 设计并运行量子电路，模拟噪声效应
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 Google 量子硬件上设计噪声感知电路
copy.tagline_en: Design and run quantum circuits, simulate noise effects
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to design noise-aware circuits for Google quantum hardware

howto.what: Claude 可以借助 Cirq 框架帮你设计、模拟和运行量子电路,支持在 Google 等量子硬件上执行实验,也能处理含噪声的电路建模与优化。
howto.when: 当你要用 Python 构建、模拟或优化量子电路,或针对 Google Quantum AI 等量子硬件运行任务、设计含噪声的电路与表征实验时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 Cirq 写一个量子电路并模拟运行。
say.note: 将调用 Cirq 构建电路并用模拟器运行。

say.text: 用 Cirq 对这个含噪声的电路做仿真,对比不同噪声强度。
say.note: 会使用噪声模型进行仿真对比。

say.text: 把这段 Cirq 电路提交到 Google 量子处理器上跑一下。
say.note: 需要 GCP 项目权限等配置。

howto.what_en: Claude can use the Cirq framework to build, simulate, and optimize quantum circuits, run experiments on Google Quantum AI and partner hardware, and handle noise-aware circuit modeling and characterization.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to build, simulate, or optimize quantum circuits in Python, target Google Quantum AI hardware, or design noise-aware circuits and characterization experiments.

say_en.text: Help me write a Cirq circuit and simulate it.
say_en.note: It will build a circuit and run the simulator.

say_en.text: Simulate this noisy circuit with Cirq and compare different noise levels.
say_en.note: Uses noise models for the comparison.

say_en.text: Submit this Cirq circuit to run on Google quantum hardware.
say_en.note: Requires GCP project access and configuration.
